###### regionPrefCookie.ts ######
/**
 * The `zimm-region-pref` cookie — records when a shopper dismissed or acted on a regional
 * prompt, so the same prompt doesn't re-fire on every page load. One cookie, two independent
 * flags:
 *
 * - `l` — language-mismatch prompt (SFCC-689), epoch seconds.
 * - `c` — country-mismatch prompt (SFCC-823), epoch seconds.
 *
 * Wire format (exact): `zimm-region-pref=1|l=<epochSeconds>|c=<epochSeconds>`, either flag
 * optional, attributes `path=/; samesite=lax; secure; max-age=<seconds>`. No `s` (manual
 * selection) flag — nothing in SFCC-831/689 writes one, and the leading `1|` version prefix
 * means a future flag can be added without breaking anything already deployed.
 *
 * Split in two, deliberately:
 * - The parse/serialise half below is pure and isomorphic — it never touches `document`, which
 *   is what would let a server-side reader (e.g. a future `request-processor.js` reading the
 *   `Cookie` header) reuse it unchanged. Verify with `grep document` if this file is ever

1. **REG-021 names three region groups** — *Asia/Oceania, Europe, Americas* — which is **not** the 6-value `boutiqueRegion` field in `countries.ts`. The grouping has no data source. Africa also has no home in that three-group list despite `/en-ch/` owning all of Africa per §1.
2. **REG-021 mandates a search field**, which your prompt's description omits. That is extra scope.
3. **REG-023 folds language into the same selector** — so "optionally language" is actually *required*, and EU-domestic is the only multi-language case.
4. **REG-026/REG-027 are routing traps:** picking China routes to HK, and picking Australia from a non-Oceania storefront routes to **HK, not AU**. A naive `country → site` map gets both wrong.

**AU gating (REG-009, REG-025):**

> **AU is gated** to AU and NZ/Pacific Island IPs only (REG-009). AU is the `x-default` hreflang and must remain crawlable, so it is never blocked at the network level. A non-AU/non-Oceania human visitor landing on AU is redirected server-side to their matched storefront before AUD pricing renders; if no storefront matches their region, fall back to HK. Search-engine and social-unfurler bots are exempt from the redirect...

Combined with REG-020's *"available on all storefronts except AU"* — **the selector must not render on the AU storefront at all.** AU is the default dev site (`defaultSite: 'ZimmermannAU'`, root `/`), so the component's default local-dev context is the one storefront where it is forbidden. Here is the analysis. --- # SFCC-801 — Refinement Analysis **"global/country-currency-selector — PWA Component"** · Epic SFCC-2 (PWA Kit Components) · Story · High · Squad-A · Assignee Marcel Angelo Navarro · Reporter Jasmijn Tsang · **Sprint 6** (moved in today, 2026-09-22; was in Sprint 5, pulled out 2026-09-09) · Labels `Custom, REG-020, REG-021, REG-022, REG-023, REG-025, Squad-A` **Story points: 3 — set by Hazel Marie Cacalda, 2026-09-08 03:13:47 UTC, `None → 3`. Never changed since.** It was set 2 seconds before the DoR checklist auto-updated to include "Estimated" and 3 seconds before `Tech design → Ready for Development`. The changelog shows a single-author administrative edit, not a visible team estimate event. **Links:** `relates to` SFCC-688, SFCC-736 (pdp/drawer, In SIT), SFCC-49 (Country List Configuration, Tech design). **No subtasks, no attachments, no `blocks`/`is blocked by` link of its own.** Note the description names SFCC-817 as a redirect owner but **SFCC-817 is not actually linked to SFCC-801** — only to SFCC-688. --- ## A. Seven-point sizing lens **1. Front-end impact?** Yes, entirely. New organism + supporting atoms/molecules under `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/`, a theme recipe registered in `overrides/app/theme/components/index.ts`, and a trigger wire-up in `overrides/app/components/footer/bottomBar/index.tsx` (Tier 2, Global Shell, both squads). **2. Requirement clear enough to size?** **No.** The AC is internally consistent as prose but contradicts the design, the PRD and the related story on four material points (see B and C). The dominant unknown is list scale — see D/E Q1. **3. Which surfaces?** PWA Kit/React only for the component itself. But the *data* pulls in SFCC integration: Confluence PRC-36/PRC-52 specify the country→currency mapping as **BM-configurable without code deployment**, which makes the currency column a backend/API dependency, not a static FE table. No Contentful (the `Region` content type, Confluence 491126816, models storefronts not geographic groups). No checkout, account, PDP/PLP. **4. Design/Figma dependencies?** Partly resolved, not fully — see C. **5. API/backend dependencies?** **Yes, and unacknowledged in the ticket.** PRC-36: *"The system will store the target currency that customers see for each shipping country. The country-to-currency mapping must be configurable in SFCC without code deployment."* Nothing in SFCC-801 references this. If currency must come from BM at runtime, there is an unscoped integration contract here. **6. Pure FE / shared / architecture input?** **Needs architecture input**, on two counts: where the 203-row country dataset lives (repo constant vs SFCC BM vs Contentful), and whether the selector is a storefront picker or a country picker (below). **7. Sizeable now?** **No.** See F. --- ## B. Four standing axes **Behaviour — ambiguous.** - **Apply vs Confirm vs Clear.** AC uses both names for one control: *"the drawer header and the **Confirm** footer remain sticky"* then *"presses the **Apply** CTA"*. The design shows **two** buttons, `CLEAR` and `APPLY`. **`CLEAR` has no AC at all** — does it reset to the current country, or to no selection (and is `APPLY` then disabled)? - **Language: prop-driven or sequential step?** SFCC-801 AC: *"rendered with showLanguageSelector=true … a Language section with radio options is rendered below the country list"* — always-visible, static. SFCC-688 AC#4: *"Given a shopper selects a country that maps to the EU Domestic storefront, **when they make that selection, then** a language selector is presented … **before the redirect fires**"* — revealed on selection. The Figma variant carries a **`Step=`** property, implying a stepped flow. These are three different interaction models. - **Default accordion state disagrees between the two Figma nodes.** Desktop template `40002218:52449` renders **all five groups collapsed**; tablet variant `40002218:39722` renders **three expanded** (North America, Europe, Asia/Oceania). AC says only the group containing the current country expands. - **Search behaviour entirely unspecified** — match on country name only, or also currency/ISO code? Does it filter within collapsed groups, and do groups auto-expand on match? **Desktop/mobile — mostly answered.** `ZimmDrawer` already implements the full responsive model. `size="small"` = 25% width with a Figma-confirmed 402px floor (`PANEL_MIN_NARROW`), which is exactly the 402px panel in the desktop template. Mobile collapse is automatic below the tablet breakpoint. **Open:** AC says *"full-width on mobile leaving a small space open at the bottom"* — that bottom gap is the `mobile` variant's `MOBILE_BOTTOM_GAP` (58px), but `small` does **not** opt into it (`zimmDrawer.css.ts` comments say the baseStyle defaults to full-height precisely so utility drawers don't inherit the PDP strip). So AC and the existing shell disagree about which variant this is. **A11y — well specified, genuinely demanding.** AC covers focus trap, arrow-key radio navigation, focus return, `aria-expanded` on groups, dialog accessible name, labelled search field, touch targets. Most of the dialog half comes free from `ZimmDrawer`. The **radiogroup-inside-accordion** pattern is the hard part and has no existing atom. Note the standing `zimmLink.css.ts` `sm`-size 22px-vs-24px touch-target shortfall recorded in `overrideStyling.md` — relevant if country rows use `ZimmLink`. **Data — the largest risk, unresolved at every layer.** - **Currency has three conflicting Confluence sources and no agreed owner.** Page 255852545 (the one SFCC-817 cites) has **zero currency data**. Page 458096644 defaults ~168 of 203 rows to the storefront base currency. Page 466059284 gives nearly every Global-e market its own local currency. They disagree on roughly half of all markets (Albania EUR vs ALL, China USD vs CNY, Argentina USD vs ARS, Iceland EUR vs ISK…). PRC-36/52 then say the real source is BM config. - **The design's own currency column contradicts repo config.** Figma shows `CANADA — CAD $` and `NEW ZEALAND — NZD $`. `config/sites.generated.js` has `ZimmermannUSIntl` (`/en-ca/`) = **USD**, and there is **no NZ site at all** (Oceania is served by AU/AUD). - **HK/ME conflict:** config + `countries.generated.ts` say HK = USD, ME = EUR; `regional.md` and TSD §5.1 say HKD / AED. - **Region grouping has three incompatible taxonomies:** Figma shows **5** (North America, Europe, Asia/Oceania, Africa, Middle East); PRD REG-021 says *"e.g. Asia/Oceania, Europe, Americas"* (**3**, and "e.g." is illustrative not normative); Confluence 255852545's `Region` column has **6** (Africa, Americas, Asia/Oceania, Europe, Middle East, Oceania). `countries.ts`'s `boutiqueRegion` is a fourth, 6-value set explicitly documented for store-locator filtering. **South America has no home in the Figma set.** - **15 markets are Disabled** (Confluence 486932513: Turkey, Iran, North Korea, Afghanistan, Somalia…). 218 − 15 = 203. The selector must exclude them; no AC says so. --- ## C. Design status **A desktop design does exist — the Jira thread's gap was closed administratively, and the outcome is only partly what the closure implies.** Timeline, reconstructed from comments (AEST) and changelog (UTC): - `2026-09-07 19:07:41+1000` Hazel: *"The design for desktop large and small are not yet available"* - `19:07:48` (7s later) Hazel removes **"Design available"** from the DoR checklist - `19:07:59` Hazel sets status **Tech design → Blocked** - `19:17:32+1000` Kiera: *"Like all the drawer comps, there are different sizes for desktop, tablet and mobile. Please refer to **these** templates within the design system for all the drawer behaviours. We've shown all the drawer templates 🙂"* - `23:31:16+1000` (~4h14m later) Hazel appends the drawer-templates link to Design/Technical Notes, then at `23:31:31` **Blocked → Tech design**, at `23:31:38` **re-ticks "Design available"**, at `23:31:46` adds "Technical approach understood / Dependencies identified / Testable" - `2026-09-08 13:13:47+1000` sets **3 points**; `13:13:50` **→ Ready for Development** **No comment after 2026-09-07 19:17 exists on the ticket.** Nobody ever stated that a desktop component design was produced. The gap was closed by accepting generic drawer templates as the answer. **What I independently verified in Figma (tool worked):** - `40002218:52449` = `PDP Drawer Template - Small (25%) - Country & Currency Selector - All storefronts except AU`, a **1440×1024 desktop frame** containing a 402px right-anchored panel. Screenshotted: it renders the real component — header `COUNTRY SELECT`, description, `Search Location` field, five collapsed region groups, `CLEAR`/`APPLY`. **So a Desktop Small composition genuinely exists.** - `40002218:39722` = `Size=Tablet, Variant=Regional Storefront - Country & Currency Selector - All storefronts except AU, Step=–`. Screenshotted: expanded groups with flag + country + right-aligned currency, radios (UK pre-selected), a `LANGUAGE` radio section (Français/Italiano/Español/English), `CLEAR`/`APPLY`. - Desktop content width is **338px** (402px panel − 32px padding each side); tablet content is **342px**. Effectively identical — which is why one content design serves both, and supports Kiera's position. - **"Desktop Large" is arguably not applicable**: `zimmDrawer.css.ts`'s own Figma-sourced size table lists *"Desktop Small — 25% — Notify Me, Wishlist, Find in Boutique, **Regional Storefront**, Cookies, Login"*. Regional Storefront is a Desktop Small drawer by design-system definition. **Still not drawn / not confirmable:** - **No AU variant seen.** Both node names say *"All storefronts except AU"*, implying a counterpart exists, but I could not enumerate it. - **The `Step=` property's other values are unknown** — directly relevant to the language-flow question. - **Figma library search does not surface this component set.** `search_design_system` for "country currency selector" returned only `PLP Bar desktop` and a `WishlistOLD` component, with library assets dated `2026-07-06`. I could reach the canvas nodes but **could not enumerate the full variant matrix**. - **Confluence has no Figma link for it at all.** Tracker 04.2 (258801666) row "Country / Region Selector" is Design Status **PENDING**, Zimmermann Sign-off **Pending**, **Figma Link column empty**, note *"23-06: is this a WIP?"*. Component Inventory 04.7 (400195591) has **no country/region/currency selector row at all**, and its one "Drawer" row reads *"Designs Empty … Incomplete"*. Tracker 04.72 (408944644) claims design finalised Aug 24 with a **blank design-lead column**. **The design's biggest signal, and it contradicts the requirements:** the rendered list is a **storefront picker (~9 rows)**, not a country picker.
